premises.text: Smooth travel planning is impossible across disconnected discovery and booking tools
premises.evidence_span: Inspiration platforms like Instagram provide discoverability, but a breakdown occurs once you want to start planning or booking your journey

premises.text: Mapify unifies sources and lets travelers share and consume journey visualizations as global hosts
premises.evidence_span: by enabling every single traveler to be a global host for the places they visit and the activities they experience

premises.text: Interest-based feed, collaborative trip planning, and magic itinerary generation with transport and lodging recommendations
premises.evidence_span: Based on our combined interests, Mapify now looks for spots that could be relevant for both of us

premises.text: Proprietary AI ranks experiences by geo relevance, quality, and personal importance
premises.evidence_span: Our proprietary algorithm sorts entire trips by geographic relevance, quality, and personal importance

premises.text: Revenue from brand/affiliate partnerships focused first on European millennial leisure travel
premises.evidence_span: We're focusing on monetizing the European subsegment first

value.text: One platform that unifies services and curates relevant personal travel experiences
value.evidence_span: integrates everything you've just seen into one single platform

secondary_value.text: Create whole travel journeys in a few seconds
secondary_value.evidence_span: create your whole travel journey in just a few seconds

notes: Merged magic button with personalization. Host framing kept as platform condition contributing to content supply.
